```{r libraries}
library(SpatialFeatureExperiment)
```

```{r configuration}
sfe_path <- project_path("Revision/Nan annotation/Data/Xenium sfe objects/Xenium sfe object/sfe_09032026.rds")
output_dir <- file.path(getwd(), "acta2_ec_scmetabolism_outputs")
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

ec_lv2_levels <- c(
  "ACKR1_EC",
  "ACTA2_EC",
  "cycling_EC",
  "EPC",
  "HEY1_EC",
  "lymphatic_EC"
)

group_levels <- c("Other_EC", "ACTA2_EC")
pathway_lookup <- c(
  "Glycolysis / Gluconeogenesis" = "Glycolysis",
  "Citrate cycle (TCA cycle)" = "TCA / OXPHOS"
)
pathway_levels <- unname(pathway_lookup)
pathway_labels <- c(
  "Glycolysis" = "Glycolysis",
  "TCA / OXPHOS" = "TCA /\nOXPHOS"
)
group_colors <- c("Other_EC" = "#4C78A8", "ACTA2_EC" = "#E45756")

to_dgC <- function(x) {
  if (inherits(x, "dgCMatrix")) return(x)
  x <- as(x, "CsparseMatrix")
  as(x, "dgCMatrix")
}

rescale01 <- function(x) {
  rng <- range(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!all(is.finite(rng)) || rng[1] == rng[2]) {
    return(rep(0.5, length(x)))
  }
  (x - rng[1]) / (rng[2] - rng[1])
}

format_p <- function(p_value) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(p_value) ~ "p = NA",
    p_value < 0.001 ~ "p < 0.001",
    TRUE ~ paste0("p = ", formatC(p_value, format = "f", digits = 3))
  )
}

save_plot_set <- function(plot, basename, width, height) {
  png_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(basename, ".png"))
  pdf_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(basename, ".pdf"))
  svg_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(basename, ".svg"))

  ggplot2::ggsave(png_file, plot, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

  grDevices::pdf(pdf_file, width = width, height = height, useDingbats = FALSE, bg = "white")
  print(plot)
  grDevices::dev.off()

  grDevices::svg(svg_file, width = width, height = height, bg = "white")
  print(plot)
  grDevices::dev.off()

  invisible(c(png_file, pdf_file, svg_file))
}
```

# ACTA2_EC versus other ECs

```{r prepare_ec_subset}
if (!exists("sfe")) {
  sfe <- readRDS(sfe_path)
}

if (!"lv2_anno_new" %in% colnames(SummarizedExperiment::colData(sfe))) {
  stop("The Xenium sfe object must contain lv2_anno_new for ACTA2_EC selection.")
}

sfe_coldata <- as.data.frame(SummarizedExperiment::colData(sfe))
sample_col <- dplyr::case_when(
  "sample_id" %in% colnames(sfe_coldata) ~ "sample_id",
  "SampleId" %in% colnames(sfe_coldata) ~ "SampleId",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)

keep_ec <- !is.na(sfe_coldata[["lv2_anno_new"]]) &
  sfe_coldata[["lv2_anno_new"]] %in% ec_lv2_levels

sfe_ec <- sfe[, keep_ec]
sfe_ec$lv2_anno_new <- factor(as.character(sfe_ec$lv2_anno_new), levels = ec_lv2_levels)
sfe_ec$acta2_ec_group <- ifelse(
  as.character(sfe_ec$lv2_anno_new) == "ACTA2_EC",
  "ACTA2_EC",
  "Other_EC"
)
sfe_ec$acta2_ec_group <- factor(sfe_ec$acta2_ec_group, levels = group_levels)

ec_counts <- as.data.frame(table(
  lv2_anno_new = as.character(sfe_ec$lv2_anno_new),
  acta2_ec_group = as.character(sfe_ec$acta2_ec_group)
)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Freq > 0)

write.csv(
  ec_counts,
  file.path(output_dir, "acta2_ec_scmetabolism_lv2_counts.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

kable(ec_counts)
```

```{r run_scmetabolism}
score_cache <- file.path(output_dir, "acta2_ec_scmetabolism_scores_matrix.rds")
meta_cache <- file.path(output_dir, "acta2_ec_scmetabolism_metadata.rds")

if (file.exists(score_cache) && file.exists(meta_cache)) {
  acta2_ec_scmetab_scores <- readRDS(score_cache)
  acta2_ec_scmetab_meta <- readRDS(meta_cache)
} else {
  ec_counts_mat <- to_dgC(SummarizedExperiment::assay(sfe_ec, "counts"))
  acta2_ec_scmetab_meta <- as.data.frame(SummarizedExperiment::colData(sfe_ec))
  rownames(acta2_ec_scmetab_meta) <- colnames(sfe_ec)

  old_assay_version <- getOption("Seurat.object.assay.version")
  options(Seurat.object.assay.version = "v3")
  acta2_ec_seurat <- Seurat::CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = ec_counts_mat,
    meta.data = acta2_ec_scmetab_meta,
    assay = "RNA",
    project = "ACTA2_EC_scMetabolism"
  )
  if (is.null(old_assay_version)) {
    options(Seurat.object.assay.version = NULL)
  } else {
    options(Seurat.object.assay.version = old_assay_version)
  }

  acta2_ec_seurat <- Seurat::NormalizeData(acta2_ec_seurat, verbose = FALSE)
  acta2_ec_seurat$acta2_ec_group <- factor(
    as.character(acta2_ec_seurat$acta2_ec_group),
    levels = group_levels
  )
  Seurat::Idents(acta2_ec_seurat) <- "acta2_ec_group"

  detected_cores <- parallel::detectCores(logical = FALSE)
  scmetab_ncores <- ifelse(is.na(detected_cores), 1, min(2, detected_cores))

  set.seed(1701)
  acta2_ec_seurat <- scMetabolism::sc.metabolism.Seurat(
    obj = acta2_ec_seurat,
    method = "AUCell",
    imputation = FALSE,
    ncores = scmetab_ncores,
    metabolism.type = "KEGG"
  )

  acta2_ec_scmetab_scores <- acta2_ec_seurat@assays$METABOLISM$score
  acta2_ec_scmetab_meta <- acta2_ec_seurat@meta.data

  saveRDS(acta2_ec_scmetab_scores, score_cache)
  saveRDS(acta2_ec_scmetab_meta, meta_cache)
}

missing_pathways <- setdiff(names(pathway_lookup), rownames(acta2_ec_scmetab_scores))
if (length(missing_pathways) > 0) {
  stop("Missing scMetabolism pathways: ", paste(missing_pathways, collapse = ", "))
}
```

```{r score_tables}
score_matrix <- as.matrix(acta2_ec_scmetab_scores[names(pathway_lookup), , drop = FALSE])
score_cells <- colnames(score_matrix)
if (is.null(score_cells) || !all(score_cells %in% rownames(acta2_ec_scmetab_meta))) {
  score_cells <- rownames(acta2_ec_scmetab_meta)[seq_len(ncol(score_matrix))]
}

score_wide <- as.data.frame(t(score_matrix), check.names = FALSE)
score_wide$cell <- score_cells
score_wide$sample_id <- if (!is.na(sample_col) && sample_col %in% colnames(acta2_ec_scmetab_meta)) {
  as.character(acta2_ec_scmetab_meta[score_cells, sample_col, drop = TRUE])
} else {
  NA_character_
}
score_wide$lv2_anno_new <- as.character(acta2_ec_scmetab_meta[score_cells, "lv2_anno_new", drop = TRUE])
score_wide$acta2_ec_group <- as.character(acta2_ec_scmetab_meta[score_cells, "acta2_ec_group", drop = TRUE])

score_long <- score_wide %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::all_of(names(pathway_lookup)),
    names_to = "scmetabolism_pathway",
    values_to = "score"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    pathway = unname(pathway_lookup[scmetabolism_pathway]),
    pathway = factor(pathway, levels = pathway_levels),
    acta2_ec_group = factor(acta2_ec_group, levels = group_levels),
    lv2_anno_new = factor(lv2_anno_new, levels = ec_lv2_levels)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    cell,
    sample_id,
    lv2_anno_new,
    acta2_ec_group,
    pathway,
    scmetabolism_pathway,
    score
  )

score_summary <- score_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(pathway, acta2_ec_group) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_cells = dplyr::n(),
    n_samples = dplyr::n_distinct(sample_id[!is.na(sample_id) & sample_id != ""]),
    mean_score = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_score = median(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25 = stats::quantile(score, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75 = stats::quantile(score, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_score = stats::sd(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_score = sd_score / sqrt(n_cells),
    ci95 = 1.96 * se_score,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

sample_summary <- score_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(sample_id), sample_id != "") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_id, pathway, acta2_ec_group) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_cells = dplyr::n(),
    mean_score = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_score = median(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

single_cell_tests <- score_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(pathway) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_other_ec = sum(acta2_ec_group == "Other_EC"),
    n_acta2_ec = sum(acta2_ec_group == "ACTA2_EC"),
    median_other_ec = median(score[acta2_ec_group == "Other_EC"], na.rm = TRUE),
    median_acta2_ec = median(score[acta2_ec_group == "ACTA2_EC"], na.rm = TRUE),
    difference_median_acta2_minus_other = median_acta2_ec - median_other_ec,
    p_value = stats::wilcox.test(score ~ acta2_ec_group, exact = FALSE)$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_adjust_bh = stats::p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    p_label = format_p(p_adjust_bh)
  )

write.csv(score_long, file.path(output_dir, "acta2_ec_scmetabolism_cell_scores.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(score_summary, file.path(output_dir, "acta2_ec_scmetabolism_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(sample_summary, file.path(output_dir, "acta2_ec_scmetabolism_sample_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(single_cell_tests, file.path(output_dir, "acta2_ec_scmetabolism_single_cell_wilcox_tests.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Summary

```{r summary_table}
kable(score_summary, digits = 4)
```

```{r single_cell_tests}
kable(single_cell_tests, digits = 4)
```

The Wilcoxon tests above compare single-cell AUCell scores between ACTA2_EC and
the other ECs. They are useful as a cell-level distribution check, but they do
not model donor/sample nesting.

## Dot Plots

```{r dotplots, fig.width=5.6, fig.height=3.4}
make_dotplot <- function(summary_df, scale_by_column = FALSE) {
  plot_df <- summary_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      pathway = factor(as.character(pathway), levels = rev(pathway_levels)),
      acta2_ec_group = factor(as.character(acta2_ec_group), levels = group_levels)
    )

  if (isTRUE(scale_by_column)) {
    plot_df <- plot_df %>%
      dplyr::group_by(pathway) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        fill_score = rescale01(mean_score),
        size_score = fill_score
      ) %>%
      dplyr::ungroup()
    legend_title <- "Column-scaled mean"
    plot_title <- "ACTA2_EC scMetabolism scores, scaled"
  } else {
    plot_df <- plot_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        fill_score = mean_score,
        size_score = rescale01(mean_score)
      )
    legend_title <- "Mean AUCell score"
    plot_title <- "ACTA2_EC scMetabolism scores"
  }

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = acta2_ec_group, y = pathway)) +
    geom_point(
      aes(fill = fill_score, size = size_score),
      shape = 21,
      color = "grey35",
      stroke = 0.35
    ) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = pathway_labels) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#D7301F", name = legend_title) +
    scale_size(range = c(7, 14), guide = "none") +
    labs(title = plot_title, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 15) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, lineheight = 0.95),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12.5),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11.5),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey88"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 6)),
      plot.margin = margin(5.5, 6, 5.5, 5.5)
    )
}

p_dot_raw <- make_dotplot(score_summary, scale_by_column = FALSE)
p_dot_scaled <- make_dotplot(score_summary, scale_by_column = TRUE)

save_plot_set(p_dot_raw, "acta2_ec_scmetabolism_dotplot_raw_reversed_axes", width = 5.6, height = 3.4)
save_plot_set(p_dot_scaled, "acta2_ec_scmetabolism_dotplot_scaled_by_column_reversed_axes", width = 5.6, height = 3.4)

p_dot_raw
p_dot_scaled
```

## Single-Cell Distributions

```{r distribution_plots, fig.width=7.2, fig.height=4.4}
p_density <- ggplot(score_long, aes(x = score, fill = acta2_ec_group, color = acta2_ec_group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.28, linewidth = 0.8, adjust = 1.05) +
  geom_vline(
    data = score_summary,
    aes(xintercept = median_score, color = acta2_ec_group),
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.55,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ pathway, nrow = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "Single-cell score distributions",
    x = "AUCell score",
    y = "Density",
    fill = NULL,
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 13.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5)
  )

p_ecdf <- ggplot(score_long, aes(x = score, color = acta2_ec_group)) +
  stat_ecdf(linewidth = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~ pathway, nrow = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "Single-cell empirical cumulative distributions",
    x = "AUCell score",
    y = "Fraction of cells",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 13.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5)
  )

set.seed(1701)
p_cell_jitter <- score_long %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    pathway = factor(as.character(pathway), levels = pathway_levels),
    acta2_ec_group = factor(as.character(acta2_ec_group), levels = group_levels)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = acta2_ec_group, y = score, color = acta2_ec_group)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.16, height = 0, alpha = 0.34, size = 1.15) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.22, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white", color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.55) +
  facet_wrap(~ pathway, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "Single-cell scores",
    x = NULL,
    y = "AUCell score",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12.5, face = "bold", angle = 15, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 13.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5)
  )

save_plot_set(p_density, "acta2_ec_scmetabolism_density", width = 7.2, height = 4.4)
save_plot_set(p_ecdf, "acta2_ec_scmetabolism_ecdf", width = 7.2, height = 4.4)
```

## Sample Means

```{r sample_plot, fig.width=7.2, fig.height=4.2}
if (nrow(sample_summary) > 0) {
  p_sample <- sample_summary %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      pathway = factor(as.character(pathway), levels = pathway_levels),
      acta2_ec_group = factor(as.character(acta2_ec_group), levels = group_levels)
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = acta2_ec_group, y = mean_score, color = acta2_ec_group)) +
    geom_point(aes(size = n_cells), alpha = 0.82, position = position_jitter(width = 0.08, height = 0)) +
    facet_wrap(~ pathway, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 6), name = "Cells per sample") +
    labs(
      title = "Sample-level means, shown descriptively",
      x = NULL,
      y = "Mean AUCell score",
      color = NULL
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12.5, face = "bold", angle = 15, hjust = 1),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 13.5, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "right",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5)
    )

  save_plot_set(p_sample, "acta2_ec_scmetabolism_sample_mean_dots", width = 7.2, height = 4.2)
  p_sample
} else {
  cat("No sample identifier was available for the EC subset.")
}
```
